facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹58,525 cr, +21% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹1,748 cr, +2% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹21,794 cr (+47% YoY), PAT ₹411 cr (−45% YoY), operating margin 2.7%.
Revenue has compounded at 43% over 10 years, 50% over 5 and 59% over 3; the last twelve months (+21%) are running behind the 3-year pace.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (56% vs 59%).
Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: +2% → +2% → +21% → +47% YoY.
Operating margin is steady at 2.7% (3.8% a year ago).
Borrowings are ₹1,236 cr against equity of ₹5,878 cr: debt/equity 0.21× (was 0.35× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 23.2× over the last twelve months.
Capital work-in-progress is ₹885 cr, 21% of fixed assets — a large build-out not yet earning.
The cash conversion cycle is −7 days, little changed from 2 in Mar 2023.
Promoters hold 28.5%, −0.4 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹4,515 cr of operating cash came from ₹4,996 cr of operating profit: 90% conversion; against PAT of ₹3,697 cr that is 1.2×.
Free cash flow was negative in 1 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹1,125 cr, latest year ₹724 cr.
Other income is 38% of pre-tax profit over the last twelve months — earnings lean on non-operating items.

business.what: Dixon Technologies is a leading Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) provider in India. It integrates design, engineering, and large-scale manufacturing to deliver products across consumer electronics, home appliances, mobile phones, wearables, hearables, and telecom/IT hardware for global and domestic brands.
business.geography: The Group operates 30 manufacturing facilities across India, serving both global and domestic brands.

claims.claim: Margins were impacted by the expiration of mobile PLI 1 and elevated global memory prices.
claims.quote: Margins during the quarter were impacted on expiration of mobile PLI 1 scheme along with elevated global memory prices due to rapid expansion of AI infrastructure.

claims.claim: In EMS business, cost pass-through is automatic with no time lag, whereas in ODM appliances, there is a time lag.
claims.quote: in our EMS business... it is an automatic pass-through. There is no time lag... But when we are looking at our appliances business... there, there is some kind of a time lag.

claims.claim: Washing machine margins compressed to 8.3% due to commodity and freight costs.
claims.quote: in a washing machine business, which is traditionally 11% EBITDA margin... the margins compressed to 8.3%.

claims.claim: Operating margin for the quarter reflected temporary compression on account of expiry of Mobile PLI 1 and increased input costs.
claims.quote: Operating margin for the quarter reflected temporary compression on account of expiry of Mobile PLI 1 in March '26 and from increased selling prices driven by elevated input costs

claims.claim: Dixon has gained market share in the mobile segment as the company maintained volumes despite a double-digit industry contraction.
claims.quote: we have gained the market share because the volume degrowth is significantly higher. So we have been kind of able to maintain our share, in fact, maintain the volumes and increase the share.

claims.claim: The company achieved an optimal working capital cycle of negative five days.
claims.quote: Enhanced working capital discipline resulted in an optimal working capital cycle of negative five days.

claims.claim: The margin profile will be slightly under pressure this year because the PLI has gone off.
claims.quote: the margin profile will be slightly under pressure this year because the PLI has gone off, and there is a lag in the margin accretion happening due to component foray.

claims.claim: Overall working capital efficiency led to stronger cash flow generation and working capital cycle of negative 8 days.
claims.quote: Overall working capital efficiency led to stronger cash flow generation and working capital cycle of negative 8 days.

claims.claim: The company's mobile business margins are currently around 3.5%, which includes PLI benefits.
claims.quote: the mobile business margins are closer to 3.5%, which has got PLI as well, broadly 0.5%, 0.6% of our share of PLI income

claims.claim: Commodity and currency risks are immediately passed on to customers in their B2B business.
claims.quote: it's a pass-through. For us, there is no impact as far as the value chain and impact on the margins is concerned on an absolute basis.

claims.claim: The company maintains a negative working capital cycle of 7 days.
claims.quote: Our working capital cycle remains at negative 7 days, complemented by a strong balance sheet, reflecting a net debt position of INR246 crores.

claims.claim: GST rate reduction in mid-August led to significant postponement of purchases across trade and consumer channels.
claims.quote: the announcement of the reduction in GST rates in mid-August led to a significant postponement of purchases across the trade and consumer channels.

claims.claim: The company maintains a strong balance sheet with a net debt position of INR 203 crores.
claims.quote: complemented by a strong balance sheet reflecting a net debt position of INR 203 crores.

claims.claim: The company expects margin pressure for a couple of quarters in FY27 due to the timing of new plant operations.
claims.quote: there can be some pressure for a couple of quarters in '27.

claims.claim: Within one year of operation we have been able to capture around 10% of the Indian market in direct cool category.
claims.quote: Within one year of operation we have been able to capture around 10% of the Indian market in direct cool category

claims.claim: We feel confident that with both deepening of manufacturing happening in India and also by leveraging on this ECMS PLI scheme, the margins potentially, which is 7%, 7.5% can go to 9%, 9.5% in the coming years.
claims.quote: We feel confident that with both deepening of manufacturing happening in India and also by leveraging on this ECMS PLI scheme, the margins potentially, which is 7%, 7.5% can go to 9%, 9.5% in the coming years.

claims.claim: In FY 26-27, we think we can expand the margins. Even after taking into account the PLI margin... we can expand the margin to almost 120, 130 bps in FY 26-27
